name: FrameCraft
summary: Independent macOS app for screen recording, automatic click zooms, and smooth cursor movement. Development version 0.3.0; 17 tests passed.
description:
## Goal

An independent, locally usable macOS app for screen recording, automatic zooms, smooth cursor movement, and video export. Screen Studio is a functional reference; implementation and interface are independent.

## Current status

Version 0.3.0 was built and launched on the Mac. All 17 automated tests pass. A real window recording was verified in 0.2 with 10 clicks, 590 cursor positions, and 6 automatic zooms. In 0.3, the same recording was exported again as Full HD MP4 with smooth camera motion.

## Documentation

This project consolidates completed work, pending checks, and proposed extensions. Details, evidence, and reuse instructions are in the project document. Done means implemented and verified to the stated extent.

## Further work

First address recording permissions across app updates and outstanding audio/display tests. Additional features remain proposals in the backlog, without committed dates or automatic implementation authorization.

## Ongoing maintenance

Create or update matching issues for future FrameCraft work; document results, version, tests, and remaining limitations. No background synchronization is configured. Local videos and app files were not uploaded to Linear.
